hypothesis: Recent root-PV churn identifies positions where completing more search has higher marginal decision value than spending the same aggregate nodes uniformly.

predeclared_policy.uniform_control: same observed mean nodes, chosen before oracle scoring
predeclared_policy.causal_ablation: shuffle the adaptive per-position node-budget distribution

gates: aggregate node totals within one percent
paired bootstrap mean-regret advantage over uniform lower bound above zero
paired bootstrap mean-regret advantage over shuffled allocation lower bound above zero
promotion: A survivor remains a diagnostic candidate until equal-node games and then fixed-time games replicate it.
rollback: Reject move voting and forced-MultiPV fragments already falsified; reject this allocator if either matched-compute or shuffled-allocation gate fails.
